name: browser-use
headline: skill-issue - Audit AI Agent Skills
short_description: skill-issue audits AI agent skills to identify issues before they impact operations. It benefits operations teams by ensuring AI agents perform optimally. It connects to other AI agent skills and workflows.
author: krispuckett

sections.overview:
skill-issue is an agent auditing skill that inventories all installed skills, tracks their usage from logs, and checks health by verifying required binaries and environment variables. It scans skill directories for SKILL.md files, analyzes dependencies, and generates a markdown report recommending which skills to keep, review, or remove based on health and activity over a configurable period. The tool runs read-only and never modifies, installs, or removes anything—making it safe for operations teams to use on production skill portfolios. Perfect for DevOps engineers and AI operations managers who need visibility into skill performance and dependency health without manual auditing.
Remove unused skills cluttering your project after analyzing 7-day usage patterns
Identify skills with missing dependencies before they break agent workflows
Track which skills are actively used across your agent infrastructure
Audit environment variables and CLI tool requirements for all skills at once
**Purpose**: Automates customer support responses in the retail industry
**Data Used**: Customer inquiries, product databases, order statuses
**Related Skills**: Order processing, inventory management, customer feedback analysis
